subject: Ad-hoc bandwidth redress request & legal clearance needed
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@acme-retail.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: payments@acme-retail.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: short-term bandwidth uplift + invoice correction

Jonas —

We're in the middle of a marketing push and our token consumption spiked unexpectedly overnight. We need a temporary increase to our concurrency threshold for the next 72 hours to avoid degraded customer experiences. Can Redwood escalate a short-window uplift from our current 8 qps to 40 qps immediately? We can supply a PO right away but our procurement team needs a clear credit/true-up note on the billing side — last month's invoice appears to have double-billed a one-off surge.

Attachments: Acme_PO_579.pdf (PO stub)

What we need from you within the day:
- Confirmation you can provide a short-term throughput bump (target: 40 qps)
- Whether there will be any pro-rated charges or a capped overrun rate for the 72-hour window
- A one-line statement we can pass to Procurement confirming Redwood will apply a credit if the prior invoice error is validated

We'd like to avoid a formal SOW or long-term commitment for this — purely temporary.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Product Operations
Acme Retail

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Priya Singh <priya@acme-retail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term bandwidth uplift + invoice correction

Priya —

Thanks for the heads up and the PO stub. Short answer: we can provide a 72-hour uplift to 40 qps from your existing 8 qps. Operational details and constraints below.

What I'll do now (action items):
- Open an operational ticket with SRE to spin up ephemeral headroom and verify routing (ETA 45 minutes)
- Hold pricing at a capped overrun rate of $0.045 per 1k tokens for the uplift window unless you prefer a fixed short-term uplift fee (we can do either)
- Assign Ben to confirm any discretionary credit for the previous invoice error; Laura will coordinate with Finance if a formal credit is required

Quick clarification requests so we size the uplift correctly:
- Is the 40 qps peak sustained/concurrent, or do you expect bursty spikes with average ~18 qps?
- Does the PO you attached cover uplift dollars or only acknowledges the request?

If you want the faster path: send a signed PO that references ACME-579 + 'temporary uplift Sept 4-7' and we'll execute immediately. I'll reply with an internal acknowledgement note you can pass to Procurement for the invoice query.

I'll follow up with pricing confirmation within the hour.

— Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Priya Singh <priya@acme-retail.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term bandwidth uplift + invoice correction

Priya / team —

We can do the capped overrun approach Jonas suggested. For this emergency 72-hour uplift we propose:

- Uplift to 40 qps effective on provisioning completion (target +45 min)
- Temporary overrun cap: $0.045 per 1k tokens (flat for uplift window)
- If the billing team confirms a prior double-charge, we will issue a one-time credit equal to the validated over-billed amount; we'll need the invoice number + payment reference to reconcile.

If you sign the attached amendment (redwood_proposed_amendment.docx) we can lock in the cap and waive any administrative fee for the change. The amendment only covers the 72-hour window and explicitly states no change to your base committed tier.

If Procurement needs a one-line confirmation for the invoice: "Redwood Inference will investigate the referenced invoice and apply any validated credit to Acme Retail's account; credits will be reflected on the following billing cycle." — happy for you to use that.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Singh <priya@acme-retail.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: payments@acme-retail.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term bandwidth uplift + invoice correction

Thanks — that language looks good for Procurement. Quick answers:
- The 40 qps is a hard cap we want available; most traffic will be bursty (avg ~20 qps) but we need concurrency headroom for the next 72 hours
- The PO covers the uplift amount (Procurement prepared a short addendum) — see attached PO stub.
- Invoice in question: Invoice #INV-2026-07-1138, paid 2026-08-04; we believe a one-time charge of ~$12.3k was duplicated. Payments team is copied.

Please proceed with provisioning. We'll sign the amendment if you can send a redline confirming the capped overrun and the 72-hour window.

— Priya

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Priya Singh <priya@acme-retail.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term bandwidth uplift + invoice correction

Hi Priya —

Operational update: uplift to 40 qps was provisioned on Sept 4 at 10:22 PT and torn down on Sept 7 at 10:30 PT as requested; telemetry shows average consumption ~19 qps and two short peaks at 38 qps. No errors observed during the window.

Billing update (follow-up): we've reviewed INV-2026-07-1138 and identified a duplicate line item consistent with your note. Finance will issue a credit of $12,300 to Acme Retail; the credit will appear as a negative line on your October invoice.

Attached: amended one-line confirmation and a DocuSign link for the uplift amendment (no long-term commitment). Please sign the amendment so we have written acceptance of the window & cap.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/tx/AXY-9Q2S

Thanks for the quick coordination — glad things stayed stable over the campaign.

Best,
Laura Bennett
